description: If the ground-term universe is nonempty, a set \(\mathcal C\) of universally asserted actual relation clauses has a model exactly when one valuation satisfies all ground clauses \(\mathcal C^g\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clause_herbrand_iff.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  [Nonempty (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L)]
  (Γ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L α)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseSatisfiable Γ ↔
    ∃ b,
      ∀ D ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundClauses Γ, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat b D
